candidates.change_summary: Replace the body of withdrawAll to transfer the contract balance to msg.sender directly instead of calling withdraw, changing who receives funds when bypassing onlyOwner (and affecting behavior if modifier is removed elsewhere).
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner (invert check), so withdrawAll can be called only by non-owners, altering who can observe balance changes after withdrawAll.
Make withdrawAll call withdraw with zero value (no funds moved), so after withdrawAll completes the contract balance remains unchanged.
Replace transfer to send (returns boolean) and do not check result, changing reversion behavior on failed sends.
Replace transfer with call and require success, which preserves behavior on success but uses low-level call semantics and gas forwarding; explicit require will revert on failure.
Delete the transfer so withdraw becomes a no-op (does not send ether), changing observed balance after call.
Relax onlyOwner check to allow any caller (remove require), so withdraw can be invoked by anyone to withdraw funds.
Replace low-level call with a transfer, changing gas forwarding and reentrancy behaviors.
Use call but check the returned success and revert on failure, making sendMoney revert on failed sends instead of silently continuing.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), altering access control so sendMoney becomes callable by non-owners.
